name: Reliance Industries

snapshot.about: Energy, petrochemicals, telecommunications, retail, FMCG, media, and new energy projects.

narrative: Management reported Q1 FY27 group revenue growth of 25%, aligning with screener revenue of ₹309,468 crore up 27.0%. However, management claimed Q1 FY27 net profit grew 6% to ₹23,200 crore, whereas reported net profit fell 24.6% year-on-year to ₹23,196 crore.

bull.point: Digital services momentum continued as Jio Platforms revenue reached ₹39,173 crore in Q1 FY27 with EBITDA margin expanding to 53.3%.

evidence.quote: Rs.39,173 Crores is the revenue, that is, 11.8% year-on-year growth
EBITDA at Rs.20,865 Crores, that is a 15.1% year-on-year growth, with an EBITDA margin of 53.3%

bull.point: FMCG business rapidly scaled revenue to ₹8,600 crore in Q1 FY27, doubling year-on-year behind strong growth across consumer product lines.

evidence.quote: This quarter, we delivered Rs. 8,600 Crores revenue on FMCG. This was double the growth as compared to last year
